sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Artane" (cons 10). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Two, the area named for Artane, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
